# FreeSolv GP Features In Plain English

This is a plain-English companion to [Python FreeSolv GP feature list](freesolv-gp-feature-list.md).

The literal feature list is still the canonical model vocabulary. This file translates each feature index into the kind of atom, bond, local neighbourhood, or bonding-system cue that a person can read. The WL neighbourhood entries are deliberately approximate summaries: they explain the centre atom, radius, repeated bond cues, nearby atom labels, and clear motif cues, not a unique named functional group assignment.

- translated features: `8396`
- `wl0` means an atom type only.
- `wl1` to `wl4` mean increasingly larger local neighbourhoods around an atom.
- `edge_label` features describe one typed edge.
- `bonding_system` features describe atom counts, edge counts, formal-charge cues, and explicit Dietz bonding systems.
